assumptions: Board is always 7 columns x 9 rows with square cells
Board background is the largest pink checkered connected region
Items are pixels inside a cell that are neither pink checker nor pale blue tile
Locked tiles show dark-red level digits on pale pink circles
Item identity is approximated by dominant color plus hue/brightness histogram similarity
limitations: No specific item-type recognition (names are colors), so some same-color different items may look similar
Digit recognition is heuristic; unreadable locked tiles may be labeled blocker
Generators are not identified, so no double-tap generation is attempted
Dimmed/overlaid tutorial frames yield no observation
